title: Seniors
statementMd:
List the names of students in grade level 12.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name FROM students WHERE grade_level = 12;
```
